title: Croatian–Ottoman wars
text:
Croatian–Ottoman Wars can refer to one of the several conflicts between the Kingdom of Croatia and the Ottoman Empire:Long Campaign (1443–1444) of the King Vladislaus II of Hungary
Hundred Years' Croatian–Ottoman War, War for Croatia - a period of near constant mostly low-intensity warfare approximately 1493–1593 
Long War (1593–1606)
Austro-Turkish War (1663–1664)
Great Turkish War (1683–1699)
Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718)
Austro-Turkish War (1787–1791)
